jyutping: dou1 syun3 hai6 jat1 go3 gaau3 fan3
usage: This phrase is used to indicate that an experience, often negative or challenging, has taught you an important lesson.
It implies that although something went wrong, you have gained knowledge or insight from it.
You can use it to reflect on past mistakes or difficulties and express personal growth.
It is commonly said after recalling an event to show acceptance and learning.
This expression is informal and works well in conversational Cantonese.

examples.sentence: 哎，今次投資冇賺錢，但都算係一個教訓啦。
examples.jyutping: ai1, gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 mou5 zaan6 cin2, daan6 dou1 syun3 hai6 jat1 go3 gaau3 fan3 laa1.
examples.meaning: Sigh, I didn’t make money on this investment, but it was a lesson learned.

examples.sentence: 被騙咗一次，都算係一個教訓，下次要小心啲。
examples.jyutping: bei6 pin3 zo2 jat1 ci3, dou1 syun3 hai6 jat1 go3 gaau3 fan3, haa6 ci3 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.meaning: I got scammed once, but it was a lesson learned; next time I have to be more careful.

examples.sentence: 雖然考試失敗，但都算係一個教訓，知道邊度需要加強。
examples.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 haau2 si3 sat1 baai6, daan6 dou1 syun3 hai6 jat1 go3 gaau3 fan3, zi1 dou3 bin1 dou6 seoi1 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4.
examples.meaning: Although I failed the exam, it was a lesson learned, now I know where I need to improve.

examples.sentence: 唔好灰心，呢次嘅經歷都算係一個教訓，將來會更好。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 fui1 sam1, ni1 ci3 ge3 ging1 lik6 dou1 syun3 hai6 jat1 go3 gaau3 fan3, zoeng1 loi4 wui5 gang1 hou2.
examples.meaning: Don’t be discouraged, this experience was a lesson learned, you will do better in the future.

related: 吸取教訓 (kap1 ceoi2 gaau3 fan3)
